name: inbox.send_to
description: Sends a complaint to the people it is about, kept in the brand's order of people.
sql: update brandbase.inbox_messages m set sent_to = array(select x.id from brandbase.inbox_people x where x.brand_id = :brand and x.id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(:people::jsonb)) order by x.position) where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand and m.done_at is null returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) || jsonb_build_object('receivedAt', brandbase.iso(m.received_at), 'doneAt', brandbase.iso(m.done_at)) as result
